# Fantozzi footsteps

Author: Fantozzi. Single-step cuts: qubodup. License: CC0-1.0.
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/fantozzis-footsteps-grasssand-stone
Original archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Fantozzi-footsteps.7z
SHA256: 415d360e0911c1c1c5355ee94023b772e6f4044f59b9b580610e7dbffd1840fd

The pack contains six Sand and six Stone recordings, each with left/right takes.
The Sand recordings are EQ-processed for the grass/foliage role; Stone serves
the ruins and lighthouse paths. The unmodified archive is kept as source.
Project edits are documented in assets/audio/footsteps_manifest.json.
CC0 dedication: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
